## Linked Issue

Refs #1895

Related: [#2282](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/2282), [#2284](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/2284). This is only the R23 partial Button-source increment. These issues remain WIP; no whole segmented-control cutover or full-file ownership takeover is claimed.

## Scope Summary

WIP preservation draft. Keep draft; do not mark Ready, merge, close related work, or publish. Runtime/tests/discovery/application module execution/browser/native/DB/frozen/qualification remain HOLD. No qualification receipts or restricted Library artifacts are accessed or reconstructed.

Delegate only the existing live/source/source-compare native buttons in `src/frontend/src/components/admin/article/ArticleWriteEditor.vue` to the existing public `FsusUiButton` adapter from `@/fsusui/button`, with `native-type="button"`. Preserve the original three click expressions, loading-disabled state, `aria-pressed`, `data-authoring-*`, content, order, groups and slot. Express the existing selected state through public variant combinations: pressed is an ordinary `primary` Button (`text=false`), unpressed is `text + default`. Remove the copied generic Button/state/disabled CSS; retain the product container layout and use only a product root margin class to keep the existing flex gaps from acquiring Button's default adjacent margin. FsusUI owns each public variant's control geometry; no consumer geometry override is added.

The complete script remains byte-identical except for the single Button import. In particular, `requestSurface`, `toggleSourceCompare`, `sessionSurface`, `sourceCompareOpen`, all MarkdownEditorAdapter props, outline, attachments, preferences/rights/security/authority, and continuity stay unchanged. A selected-surface click still invokes the original handler that closes source compare; no SegmentedControl or re-selection suppression is introduced. Keyboard behavior stays with the native button rendered by the public Button; actual runtime/keyboard acceptance remains HOLD.

Exact requested Blog base: `d5773ef97f55176a1eab67e677790f3e13352a7b`; baseline SFC blob: `a23a956c4f0f5b75234de52e9e0bcd52f8ce6acd`. The PR uses a task-specific base ref pinned to that commit because the existing combination branch has advanced to `0c96259e00f9d39d41824110f63c3cc260a2cbf3`. No later metadata or other source is incorporated.

Exact head: `205d8e9aea106a4331ed3bb0f85f528b5c1f6240`; its parent is the initial R23 commit `3f9ff4da61c5b1f20d188bd7c416bb961bc1f71f`, whose parent is the exact requested base. Head SFC blob: `414013097a93543222043d59e3458bcf86880d65`. The complete PR diff is one file, 21 inserted and 29 removed lines. The P2 correction alone changes only three template lines.

Independent P2 review correctly found that the first increment's unconditional text variant caused UI961's later `.button.is-text` theme rule to give primary/default the same transparent background and regular color. The correction uses the existing public `text` Boolean inversely to each unchanged pressed expression. Pressed buttons therefore do not acquire the text class and retain the public primary variant's persistent fill; unpressed buttons retain the public text variant. This source-backed variant distinction is not a rendered acceptance claim. No private selector or copied hover/focus/disabled/selection kernel is introduced. The separate upstream coarse-focus owner is not modified.

Real local source alias for the static checks: `FSUSBLOG_USE_LOCAL_FSUSUI=1`, `FSUSBLOG_LOCAL_FSUSUI_ROOT=/workspace/FsusUI-R23-base`; this clean detached checkout is exactly UI961 `c77281165226ffd84223c4c8d43805c5deb2b1b3`. Source identity is traced through the existing Blog adapter to the public package entry and UI961 Button. Existing dependency links are reused; no install/package publication or theme/Wasm build is performed. Other saved task branches/checkouts are not edited.

Full application typecheck remains red with the same 29 diagnostics at base/head. Full static acceptance and all product qualification are not passed.

## Notes For Reviewers

The parent delegated exclusive ownership of this one file for R23 after the previous task terminated with container failure and no writes. No concurrent full-file host owner is taken over. No canonical handler/authority was changed.

Repository documentation changes are not needed because this restores ownership through an existing public adapter without changing product contracts. Backend, wire/ABI, AEDS, DB, security/auth/moderation/PoW/privacy and performance implementations are not touched; their review checkboxes record this bounded not-applicable assessment, not dynamic verification. No generated output or formatting-only evidence is created.

The commit carries `[skip ci]` solely to preserve the explicit execution HOLD. No shared gate/workflow/configuration is changed, no workflow is enabled or manually dispatched, and skipped/pending remote checks are not passing acceptance.

Current P2 static comparison is `3f9ff4da61c5b1f20d188bd7c416bb961bc1f71f` versus `205d8e9aea106a4331ed3bb0f85f528b5c1f6240`, using the same exact clean UI961 local alias. Fresh logs remain outside the PR at `/tmp/R23-p2`; no historical prior-task result is substituted.

- `git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD`: exit 0.
- The complete script and style blocks are byte-identical to the previous R23 head (`cmp` exit 0). The original Blog-base script still differs only by the one public Button import. No handlers, authority/state/continuity/attachment code or product CSS is changed by the P2 correction. Source diff inspection shows only the three conditional `text` bindings; all original ARIA/data/disabled/native-type/click bindings are preserved.
- `FSUSBLOG_USE_LOCAL_FSUSUI=1 FSUSBLOG_LOCAL_FSUSUI_ROOT=/workspace/FsusUI-R23-base node tools/frontend/check-frontend-style.mjs --mode strict-full`: previous and current head both exit 1, missing the two configured executables at `tools/frontend/style-toolchain/node_modules/.bin/eslint` and `.../stylelint`. Raw logs are byte-identical (`cmp` exit 0), SHA-256 `2465fa06dd0a14c78f5a0eadf423b33a8dc7b43ebae5ba240a015e59d585ebf0`. No style pass, alternate tool, reduced configuration, or suppressed finding.
- `FSUSBLOG_USE_LOCAL_FSUSUI=1 FSUSBLOG_LOCAL_FSUSUI_ROOT=/workspace/FsusUI-R23-base node src/frontend/scripts/run-local-fsusui-typecheck.mjs --application`: previous and current head both exit 2 with 29 diagnostics. Raw logs are byte-identical (`cmp` exit 0), SHA-256 `34169d2a1f7846a9f5f912f9e940c7e16b0d3056623d3f912f74ab9331208b41`. Both use the original complete application project without reduced includes or altered compiler settings. No diagnostic names the changed SFC; no new type diagnostic is introduced in this comparison. Overall typechecking remains failed.
- Complete previous/current script SHA-256: `41b2e382c5759ccb59932a1ca3812caaf5756af25094d325a4d773ac0ea8e0ab`. Complete previous/current style SHA-256: `54ebc8b03dcd0a36c3e1dafd9fc1511f7dbf71014a3fa00248798f9ef8176142`. Both pairs compare byte-identically. The original Blog-base script minus the sole Button import, and the original adapter/outline prefix, were also compared again and remain identical.
- Geometry #971 was delivered first at `eac9f71d134c487f46f60f5b2506e1a1b2854b8f`; its worktree remains clean and is not incorporated. The exact UI961 alias remains unchanged. At metadata inspection, #4388 is OPEN/draft at the exact base/head above with an empty `statusCheckRollup`. No remote qualification is claimed. R23, UI961 alias, and geometry worktrees are clean.

The only generated project is the original static typecheck producer's ignored temporary configuration; no frozen fixture/catalog/schema/receipt/qualification output, shared gate, baseline, package or test is changed. Tests/discovery/runtime/application module evaluation/browser/native/DB/qualification were not executed. The Button source and public export chain were read only.
